items.stem: What does 'open-weight' most directly mean for a language model?

options.text: The trained model weights are available to download and run yourself
options.rationale: Correct: open-weight means the weights can be obtained and run.

options.text: The model is guaranteed free for any commercial use
options.rationale: Licenses vary; open weights are not automatically unrestricted.

options.text: The training data is always fully public
options.rationale: Open weights do not imply open data.

options.text: The model can only be used via an API

items.explanation: Correct: open-weight means the weights can be obtained and run.

Model size versus available hardware and budget

items.stem: Why is a rollback and versioning plan important when self-hosting a model?

options.text: A new version can regress behaviour, so you need to revert quickly
options.rationale: Correct: versioning lets you recover from a bad update.

options.text: Models never change behaviour between versions

options.rationale: Versioning is about operations, not accuracy.

options.text: Rollback removes the need for monitoring
options.rationale: Monitoring is still needed to detect issues.

items.explanation: Correct: versioning lets you recover from a bad update.
